en.text: You are weak.

original: 私の足は弱い。

en.text: My legs are weak.

original: トムって、胃が弱いのよ。

en.text: Tom has a weak stomach.

original: 彼女に甘えられると弱いんだ。

en.text: She makes me melt when she pampers me.

original: イケメンに弱いのよね。

en.text: I have a weakness to handsome men.

original: 女って、どうしてプレゼントに弱いんだ？

en.text: Why are women so weak to presents?

original: 「遅かったわね」「あぁ。『いい仕事するなぁ』って言われてさぁ。断れなくなって、ついついこんな時間までやっちゃった」「ほんと、褒め言葉に弱いんだから」

en.text: "You're late." "Yeah. I was told I've been doing such a good job, so I couldn't say no, and I ended up working late." "You really are a sucker for flattery."

original: 自分の弱さを認めることほど難しいことはないと思う。

en.text: I don't think there's anything so difficult as recognizing one's own weakness.

original: 私の弱さゆえに、あなたを傷つけてしまった。

en.text: Because of my weakness, I hurt you.

original: 僕、じゃんけん弱いんだ。じゃんけんの必勝法ってないのかな。

en.text: I'm no good at rock-paper-scissors. I wonder if there's some sort of winning strategy to it.
